mindsetPacks.title: 🧠 Progress > perfection
mindsetPacks.body: Every aligned meal is a vote for the identity you're building.

mindsetPacks.title: 💪 Antifragile consistency
mindsetPacks.body: It's the weekly average that counts, not a single meal.

mindsetPacks.title: 🚀 Micro-habits
mindsetPacks.body: 1% better each day → massive cumulative effect.

mindsetPacks.title: 🌱 Kindness
mindsetPacks.body: Talk to yourself like a friend you want to help.

mindsetPacks.title: 🌿 Nature & light
mindsetPacks.body: 10–15 min outside recharges your biological clock.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧘 Slow breathing
mindsetPacks.body: 4s in, 6s out, 3 min: calms the system.

mindsetPacks.title: 🔥 Zen digestion
mindsetPacks.body: Really chew and take a real pause during the meal.

mindsetPacks.title: 🛡️ Daily immunity
mindsetPacks.body: Sleep, micronutrients, gentle movement: winning trio.

mindsetPacks.title: 💤 Deep sleep
mindsetPacks.body: 45 min digital curfew + morning light.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧩 Stable blood sugar
mindsetPacks.body: Vegetables first → protein/fat → carbs.

mindsetPacks.title: 🏃 Break up movement
mindsetPacks.body: 2 min of stretching/walking every 60–90 min.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧴 Useful minerals
mindsetPacks.body: Sweating a lot? A bit of quality salt on whole foods.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧭 Intention of the day
mindsetPacks.body: One simple, completed action > 10 unfulfilled intentions.

mindsetPacks.title: 🍽️ Nutrient density
mindsetPacks.body: Colorful plate = wider micronutrient spectrum.

mindsetPacks.title: 🫀 Quality fats
mindsetPacks.body: Omega-3 & olive oil: an anti-inflammatory base.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧠 Morning focus
mindsetPacks.body: Protein- and fiber-rich breakfast = clear thinking.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧊 Active recovery
mindsetPacks.body: The day after a hard session: 10–20 min easy cardio.

mindsetPacks.title: 📓 Brief journal
mindsetPacks.body: In the evening: 1 win, 1 area to improve, 1 gratitude.

mindsetPacks.title: 💡 Energy rituals
mindsetPacks.body: Light, water, breathing: quick switches.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧩 Clarity at the supermarket
mindsetPacks.body: A written list = 80% of nutrition decisions already made.

mindsetPacks.title: 🥗 Simple prep
mindsetPacks.body: Minimal batch cooking: grain + legume + 2 vegetables.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧃 Sugary drinks
mindsetPacks.body: Save them for chosen moments, not everyday.

mindsetPacks.title: 🔁 Anti-stress routine
mindsetPacks.body: Breathing + short walk after a meal = calmer nerves.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧪 Test & feedback
mindsetPacks.body: Test, observe, adjust: your body is your best lab.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧯 Background inflammation
mindsetPacks.body: Sleep, omega-3, fiber, stress → the main levers.

mindsetPacks.title: 🎯 One target per week
mindsetPacks.body: A single focused lever = much better adherence.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧊 Cool water, clear ideas
mindsetPacks.body: Mild dehydration = drop in cognitive performance.

mindsetPacks.title: 🌈 Colors = micronutrients
mindsetPacks.body: Aim for 3 colors per plate.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧰 Useful tools
mindsetPacks.body: Kitchen scale & water bottle = outsized impact.

mindsetPacks.title: 🧭 Nutritional identity
mindsetPacks.body: "I'm someone who takes care of my energy."

mindsetPacks.title: 🛒 Local sourcing
mindsetPacks.body: Prioritize whole, local, seasonal foods: more nutrients and less processing.

mindsetPacks.title: 🗄️ Environment management
mindsetPacks.body: If it's in the cupboard, it'll get eaten. Stock visible 'good' foods.

mindsetPacks.title: ⚖️ Mental weight of choice
mindsetPacks.body: Eat the same thing for breakfast and/or lunch to lighten decision fatigue.

mindsetPacks.title: 👂 Listening to your body
mindsetPacks.body: Tell the difference between stomach hunger (physical) and eye/head hunger (emotional).

mindsetPacks.title: 🖥️ Evening digital detox
mindsetPacks.body: Block screens (phone/PC) 1h before bed (blue light).

mindsetPacks.title: 📚 Deep Work (Focus)
mindsetPacks.body: Block 90 min with no interruptions/notifications for your most important task.

mindsetPacks.title: 🌅 Evening intention
mindsetPacks.body: Before sleeping, note what will be tomorrow's first successful action.

mindsetPacks.title: 🍃 Sensory grounding
mindsetPacks.body: When stressed, name 5 things you see, 4 you touch, 3 you hear.

mindsetPacks.title: 🙏 Brief gratitude
mindsetPacks.body: Note 3 things you appreciated in your day to anchor the positive.

mindsetPacks.title: 🌪️ Emotional clearing
mindsetPacks.body: Identify and name the dominant emotion of the moment. This reduces its intensity (science-backed).

mindsetPacks.title: 🔇 Noise management
mindsetPacks.body: Avoid noisy environments during meals. Sound stress affects digestion.

mindsetPacks.title: 🍎 Mindful eating
mindsetPacks.body: Take 3 deep breaths before the first bite to reconnect with your meal.

sedentaire: 2–3x/week 20–30 min: brisk walk, easy cycling or bodyweight strength.
Steps/day target 6–8k, split after meals (8–12 min).
5 min mobility in the morning + 5 min in the evening (hips/spine/shoulders).
2–3 min of slow stretching at the end of the day.
**NEAT (non-exercise activity)**: stand while on the phone, tidy up, walk while thinking.
perte: Short, frequent sessions > long, rare ones.
Waist measurement 1x/week as a simple marker.
**NEAT focus**: increase non-exercise activity to burn calories without stressing recovery.
masse: Surplus +10–15%, protein 1.6–2.2 g/kg, carbs around sessions.
Progress load or volume (not both at once).
Sleep >7 h, cut volume if <6.5 h.
Stay well hydrated: think electrolytes if sweating heavily.
Controlled eccentric emphasis (3 s) for hypertrophy.
Complex carbs pre/post session + easy proteins.
Evening magnesium through food (almonds, greens, cocoa).
**Power/Speed**: 1 light session a month focused on explosiveness (jumps/throws).
maintien: Active recovery the day after a hard session.
1 fun day (a sport you enjoy) for adherence.
Hydration + a bit of salt if sweating heavily.
**Max strength**: keep a strength cycle to preserve neuromuscular recruitment.

hydration.title: 💧 Hydration: a silent boost
hydration.insight: 1 glass/meal + 2 glasses between meals. Regular sips.

hydration.title: ⚖️ Water & blood sugar
hydration.insight: Thirst often mimics hunger. Drink before a snack.

omega3.title: 💤 Omega-3 & sleep
omega3.insight: Omega-3 status correlates with better sleep quality.

omega3_ALA.title: 🌰 Plant ALA
omega3_ALA.insight: Ground flax/chia, walnuts: 1 tbsp/day = plant ALA base.

omega6.title: 🌻 Useful omega-6
omega6.insight: Quality and gentle cooking to preserve the fats.

omega9.title: 🫒 Omega-9 & longevity
omega9.insight: A drizzle raw or at the end of gentle cooking.

vitA.title: 👀 Vitamin A
vitA.insight: Carrot/sweet potato + a bit of fat.

vitK.title: 🦴 Vitamin K
vitK.insight: Leafy greens + a bit of oil.

Bgroup.title: ⚡ B complex
Bgroup.insight: B1/B2/B3/B6 = the cogs of ATP production.

iron.title: 🩸 Iron & oxygenation
iron.insight: Pair plant iron with vitamin C.

magnesium.title: 😌 Magnesium
magnesium.insight: Almonds, cocoa, leafy greens, magnesium-rich water.

calcium.title: 🧱 Calcium & D
calcium.insight: Spread out intake + good D status.

digestion.title: 🔥 Calm digestion
digestion.insight: Step away from screens, breathe before eating.

digestion.title: 🧪 Personal tolerances
digestion.insight: Note what works well for you.

sleep.title: ☀️ Morning light
sleep.insight: 10–15 min outside as soon as possible.

proteines_veg.title: 🌱 Complete plant proteins
proteines_veg.insight: Pair a legume + a grain (rice + lentils) for a complete amino acid profile.

proteines_veg.title: 🍲 Optimal absorption
proteines_veg.insight: Soak and rinse legumes to improve their digestibility.

sodium.title: 🧂 Quality sodium
sodium.insight: Use whole sea salt or Himalayan salt for the minerals (in moderation).

sodium.title: 🏃 Post-exercise electrolytes
sodium.insight: After an intense/long effort: water + a pinch of salt + lemon/fruit juice.

iode.title: 🌊 Iodine & thyroid
iode.insight: Seaweed (nori, wakame) 1–2x/week, or iodized salt if you eat little seafood.

antistress_aigu.title: 🧊 Quick cold water
antistress_aigu.insight: A splash of cool water on your face or neck for a 'reset'.

sante_intestinale.title: 🦠 Microbiome & mood
sante_intestinale.insight: Eat a variety (30 different plants/week) to feed bacterial diversity.

sante_intestinale.title: 🍎 Prebiotics (food)
sante_intestinale.insight: Make these foods a daily base to feed the good bacteria.

sante_intestinale.title: 🥛 Probiotics (bacteria)
sante_intestinale.insight: Introduce a small amount each day to enrich your flora.

lumiere_environnement.title: 💡 Strong morning light
lumiere_environnement.insight: Throw open the windows/go outside 10 min within an hour of waking.

lumiere_environnement.title: 🕶️ Blue light filter
lumiere_environnement.insight: Use blue-light-blocking glasses or filters (Night Shift) after 7pm.

cognition_focus.title: ✅ The rule of 3
cognition_focus.insight: Write down the 3 NON-NEGOTIABLE tasks you must get done.

cognition_focus.title: ☕ Caffeine timing
cognition_focus.insight: Wait 60–90 min after waking for your first coffee/tea.

sante_feminine.title: 🩸 Cycle & nutrients
sante_feminine.insight: Follicular phase: protein + vitamin E. Luteal phase: fiber + magnesium.

sante_feminine.title: 🤰 Fertility & fats
sante_feminine.insight: Optimize omega-3 intake and avoid trans fats for egg/sperm quality.

detox_foie.title: 🌿 Daily liver support
detox_foie.insight: Cruciferous vegetables (cabbage, broccoli) + sulfur-rich foods (garlic, onion) every day.

detox_foie.title: 💦 Elimination organs & hydration
detox_foie.insight: Drink warm lemon water in the morning to stimulate the liver and kidneys.

antioxydants_poly.title: 🍇 Champion polyphenols
antioxydants_poly.insight: Dark berries, green tea, raw cocoa, turmeric: eat raw and varied.

antioxydants_poly.title: 🌈 The ORAC spectrum
antioxydants_poly.insight: The more colorful and bitter the food, the higher its antioxidant potential. Don't overcook it!
